skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the main points of longer conversations on diverse topics such as culture, society, education, travel, work, environment, past actions, future plans, opinions about people or things.
Communicate relatively independently and comfortably on a wide range of everyday life topics; express and defend personal opinions on simple issues in life.
Read and understand longer texts with diverse contents in daily life; draw simple conclusions from given information.
Write a short essay around 150 words to present and defend personal opinions on common social issues, using basic linking devices, coherent structure, persuasive arguments.
